name: aiya-chat-team
description: Chat quality team plugin for AIYA shop owners: a 3 position team (chat_head, chat_responder, chat_followup) matching the AIYA chat team itself, an 8-skill playbook (answer from knowledge, brand voice, handoff to human, triage urgency, price and stock reply, buying signal to sales, daily room digest, apology and remedy), draft-first workflows that never send a message to a real customer without a human clicking send
